text:
maria: Heads-up: observed steady GPU memory growth on H100 during long-context paged-KV runs (200k tokens). Heap delta ~1.6-1.9GB over ~2 hours.
maria: Repro command I used: `./run_infer --model t5-xl-paged --ctx 200000 --batch 1 --kv-mode paged --evict-policy lru` on node h100-14. Ran with `--kv-debug=pt,evict`.
cheng: can you share a minimal stress script? also which driver/cuda version on the H100 nodes?
maria: stress script: `stress_kv --nodes h100-14,h100-15 --seqlen 120000 --parallel 4 --run-for 7200 --kv-debug=pt`; CUDA 12.2, driver 535.54.03. A100 shows intermittent small growth; RTX farm doesn't reproduce.
sam: logs look interesting. grep: `kvcache: evict page id=0x7ffb2a8c refcnt=0 queued=1 async_done=1` then later `kvcache: page reuse id=0x7ffb2a8c refcnt=0 mapped=false` and `pagetable: checksum 0x4a9b != meta 0x0 slot=9403` in debug build.
dmitri: we added pt checksum in rev #1892. That mismatch means metadata doesn't match what PT expects. likely a race between async eviction completion (host<->gpu flush) and reuse path that rebinds page.
cheng: timeline hypothesis: eviction kicks async host flush but doesn't clear PT atomically; free-list pop can hand same page to another request which writes new meta; when eviction completion arrives it applies stale host->gpu writes or clears meta incorrectly -> PT inconsistent or incorrectly mapped.
alisha: reproduced something similar on MI250 (ROCm) but the symptom was 'orphaned' PT entries: pages show no refs but PT still points to a stale physical addr, monitor can't reclaim. ordering semantics on ROCm differ (no implicit stream sync across devices) so ordering bug shows up differently.
infra-bot: New issue created: INF-4127 - "kv: eviction completion races with reuse -> pt checksum mismatches / memory growth" (assigned to eng-runtime). :white_check_mark:
maria: sample debug excerpt (from h100-14):
```
[evict] kvcache: evict page id=0x7ffb2a8c slot=9403 refcnt=0 queued=1 async_token=0x1a2
[reuse] kvcache: reuse page id=0x7ffb2a8c slot=9403 refcnt=0 mapped=false
[pagetable] checksum 0x4a9b != meta 0x0 at slot 9403
WARN: pt: mapping stale but refcnt 0
```
sam: mitigation idea: give each page a small 64-bit epoch/version. When evict path schedules async host flush, capture page->version. On async completion, validate page->version still matches before applying host->gpu writes or clearing PT entries. If mismatch, drop completion and free host buffer.
cheng: also ensure push/pop to free-list and clearing PT entry are done with proper host-side barriers. On CUDA we can use event ordering + cudaStreamWaitEvent, and an atomic write for PT invalidation. On ROCm explicit host memory fences (`__sync_synchronize` or equivalent) may be needed.
dmitri: +1 for epoch guard. We should also convert PT clear -> atomic compare-and-swap where we only clear if expected version matches. that'll make the path robust across reorderings.
alisha: can we add a dev-only assert: in eviction completion assert `pt->version == completion_version` and crash+collect logs if mismatch? would help get stack traces for both H100 and MI250.
sam: yes add dev assert and a metric: `kv.pt_completion_mismatch{gpu_arch=...}` to surface frequency. also add telemetry for free-list reuses per-second and async latency distribution.
maria: temporary short-term workaround: throttle reuse of recently-evicted pages by applying a short quarantine (e.g., 1ms) before pushing back to free-list. helps on H100 farm reproductions.
cheng: long term: implement epoch + CAS clear + stream ordering changes. I'll prototype epoch-based guard this week.
dmitri: assign follow-ups: 1) add pt-version field + CAS clear (PR by cheng) 2) dev assert + metric (PR by sam) 3) small quarantine + config toggle (PR by marie? but maria is out) -> i'll pick it up. 4) add repro runner into CI bench farm with H100 and MI250 lanes so we don't regress.
alisha: I'll run MI250 repro with ROCm tracing and capture kernel timestamps once we have dev build with asserts.
maria: thanks all. linux core dumps and nvprof traces uploaded to INF-4127. keeping the stress run live for another 12h and will post updates.
sam: good. once epoch guard lands we'll validate with stress_kv and report leak delta. :thumbsup:
